name: Everybody's Live with John Mulaney
description: John Mulaney conducts the first-ever celebrity sit-down talk show. Live every week.

videos.title: Lending People Money
videos.overview: John sits with guests Michael Keaton, Joan Baez, Fred Armisen and personal finance columnist Jessica Roy. Musical guest Cypress Hill performs.

videos.title: Cruises
videos.overview: John sits with guests Ben Stiller, Nick Kroll, Quinta Brunson and cruise industry expert Anne Kalosh. Musical guests Kim Gordon and Kim Deal perform.

videos.title: Funeral Planning
videos.overview: John sits with guests Pete Davidson, Henry Winkler, Luenell and funeral director Raymundo Perez-Plasencia. Musical guest Mannequin Pussy performs.

videos.title: Squatters
videos.overview: John sits with Wanda Sykes, John Waters, Stavros Halkias and Supreme Court lawyer Neal Katyal. Music by Daniel Hope and New Century Chamber Orchestra.

videos.title: Getting Fired
videos.overview: John sits with Bill Hader, Johnny Knoxville, Chelsea Peretti and HR executive and employee coach Catie Maillard. Musical guest Bartees Strange.

videos.title: Heights
videos.overview: John is live with guests David Letterman, Hannibal Buress, Leanne Morgan and Nikki Glaser. Musical performance by Randy Newman.

videos.title: Are Dinosaurs Put Together Correctly?
videos.overview: John discusses whether dinosaurs are put together correctly with Conan O’Brien, Ayo Edebiri and Tina Fey. Music by Metz.

videos.title: Can Major Surgery Be Fun?
videos.overview: John discusses if you should get surgery with guests Molly Shannon, Marc Maron and Ronny Chieng. Music by John Cale and Maggie Rogers.

videos.title: Are You Ready for Real ID?
videos.overview: John asks if you're ready for Real ID with Robby Hoffman, Ramy Youssef, Andy Samberg and expert Aixa Diaz. Music by Destroyer and Jessica Pratt.

videos.title: Why Can't I Sleep?
videos.overview: John discusses sleep issues with Sarah Silverman, Patton Oswalt, Steve Guttenberg and neuroscientist Dr. Rahul Jandial. Music by Alanis Morissette.

videos.title: Is Uber Good?
videos.overview: John asks if Uber is good with guests Sigourney Weaver, Natasha Lyonne, Amy Sedaris and transit expert Alissa Walker. Music by Yeule.

videos.title: What Is on the Minds of Teens?
videos.overview: John fights three 14-year-olds and asks what's on the minds of teens with Sean Penn, Joe Mande and more. Music by Sleater-Kinney with Fred Armisen.
